-- ── Strings (GlobalStrings.lua, verbatim) ─────────────────────────────────────────────── local CONFIRM_BINDER = "Do you want to make %s your new home?" -- l.840 local ACCEPT = "Accept" -- l.10 local CANCEL = "Cancel" -- l.464
-- ── The confirm — answering to StaticPopup.lua l.1308-1322 ───────────────────────────── -- This is the dialog's ONLY teardown, and it is a poll rather than an event: walk out of -- the innkeeper's range and the question leaves the screen by itself, with no packet -- either way. `CheckBinderDist()` is the engine binding behind it -- (`benilla-ui/src/script/binder.rs`), false as soon as the app's NPC-session guard has -- closed the question. Named rather than inlined into the entry, because "the question -- expires when you walk away" is the interesting half of this file. local function hideOnceOutOfRange(_, dialog) if not CheckBinderDist() then dialog:Hide() end end
StaticPopupDialogs["CONFIRM_BINDER"] = { text = CONFIRM_BINDER, button1 = ACCEPT, button2 = CANCEL, OnAccept = function() ConfirmBinder() end, OnUpdate = hideOnceOutOfRange, timeout = 0, hideOnEscape = 1, }
-- ── The UIParent event arm (UIParent.lua l.547-548) ──────────────────────────────────── -- arg1 is the area name the "%s" takes. function BenillaBinderConfirmDriver_OnEvent() if event == "CONFIRM_BINDER" then StaticPopup_Show("CONFIRM_BINDER", arg1) end end
